908   function saveDraft() { try { if (say && say.value.trim()) localStorage.setItem(DRAFT_KEY, say.value); else localStorage.removeItem(DRAFT_KEY); } catch (e) {} }
909   function clearDraft() { try { localStorage.removeItem(DRAFT_KEY); } catch (e) {} }
910   if (say) {
911     say.addEventListener('input', function () { clearTimeout(_draftT); _draftT = setTimeout(saveDraft, 250); });
912     window.addEventListener('beforeunload', saveDraft);
913     try { var keptDraft = localStorage.getItem(DRAFT_KEY); if (keptDraft && keptDraft.trim() && !say.value.trim()) { say.value = keptDraft; receipt('Your unsent text is back in the box.'); } } catch (e) {}
914   }
915   // the Seeds button opens the seed panel; a seed's button puts the steward's verb in the composer — Send is the word
916   var seedBtn = $('#seedBtn'), seedPanel = $('#seedPanel');
917   if (seedBtn && seedPanel) seedBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
918     var open = seedPanel.classList.toggle('open'); seedBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
919   });
920   $$('#seedPanel .go[data-seed-text]').forEach(function (g) {
921     g.addEventListener('click', function () {
922       if (!say) return;
923       say.value = 'make ' + g.getAttribute('data-seed-text') + ' an initiative in tier 3';
924       say.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
925       say.focus(); say.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
926       receipt('The verb is in the composer — add the tier or the life area if you want, then Send.');
927     });
928   });
929   // W2c-2 (2026-09-30, his word: the dialogue must "engage the steward and then show the dialogue"): the composer is
930   // ONE box. A Campaign verb and the new-project ask are answered by the High Seat's own route as before (a receipt,
931   // the confirm card); anything else is said to the Campaign's steward — the Desk — and the exchange shows below, live
932   var CAVE_DIR = (document.getElementById('dialogue') && document.getElementById('dialogue').getAttribute('data-dir')) || '';   // the Cave's own conversation (2026-10-02)
933   var dlg = (window.StewardDialogue && CAMPAIGN) ? window.StewardDialogue.init({
934     pid: CAMPAIGN, dir: CAVE_DIR, headers: headers, receipt: receipt, receiptKey: 'highseat_receipt',
935     steward: (window.ANCHOR_BOOT && window.ANCHOR_BOOT.steward) || 'The steward', stamp: (window.ANCHOR_BOOT && window.ANCHOR_BOOT.stamp) || '',
936     goalName: function (id) { var g = $('.grow[data-g="' + id + '"] .gn'); return (g && g.textContent.trim()) || id; },
937     openGoal: function (id) { window.open('/project/' + encodeURIComponent(CAMPAIGN) + '?open=' + encodeURIComponent(id), '_blank', 'noopener'); },   // the goal's place, as the rendered chip opens it (Grok W2c-2)
938     onAuth: function () { showLogin('The steward’s words cannot reach this page until this browser is logged in.'); },
939     you: YOU, onStamp: function (st) { renew('The steward changed the record \u2014 the page is renewed.', st); }   // W3b: never under an open tile or his typing
940   }) : null;
941   // the box he types into is always in view (his word, 2026-10-02): the column ends at the window's foot wherever the
942   // page is scrolled (sticky alone left the composer ~150 px below the fold until he scrolled), and the box grows with
943   // his dictation like the AI cockpit - the conversation above gives way, shifted up, never the box
944   (function () {
945     var panel = document.querySelector('.panel');
946     function fit() {
947       if (!panel) return;
948       if (getComputedStyle(panel).position !== 'sticky') { panel.style.height = ''; return; }   // narrow screens: one column, no pin
949       var top = Math.max(12, panel.getBoundingClientRect().top);
950       panel.style.height = Math.max(320, window.innerHeight - top - 12) + 'px';
951     }
952     function grow() {
953       if (!say) return;
954       if (window.StewardDialogue) StewardDialogue.fitComposer(say);
955       var ex = document.getElementById('exScroll'); if (ex) ex.scrollTop = ex.scrollHeight;
956     }
957     fit(); grow();
958     window.addEventListener('scroll', fit, { passive: true });
959     window.addEventListener('resize', function () { fit(); grow(); });
960     if (say) { say.addEventListener('input', grow); say.addEventListener('focus', fit); }
961     setTimeout(fit, 400);
962   })();
963   function doSend() {
964     var text = (say.value || '').trim(); if (!text || send.disabled) return;
965     send.disabled = true; send.textContent = 'Thinking…';
966     fetch('/api/ecgberht/high_seat_say', { method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ text: text, verbs_only: !!dlg }) })
967       .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
968       .then(function (j) {
969         send.disabled = false; send.textContent = 'Send';
970         if (j && j.ok && j.talk && dlg) { dlg.send(text, null, dlg.mainList(), send, say, DRAFT_KEY); return; }   // not a verb: the steward, in the dialogue
971         if (!j || !j.ok) { receipt((j && (j.say || j.message || j.error)) || 'No answer came back — nothing was done.', true); return; }
972         say.value = ''; say.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); clearDraft(); receipt(j.say || '…', false, j.undo || null);
973         if (j.campaign_act && !j.read_only) {   // the Campaign tile shows the change after the reload; the line and its undo survive it
974           try { sessionStorage.setItem('highseat_receipt', JSON.stringify({ text: j.say, undo: j.undo || null })); } catch (e) {}
975           setTimeout(function () { location.reload(); }, 900); return;
976         }
977         if (j.project_create && j.project_create.folder) projectCard(j.project_create);   // R11: the card is here, not on the old dashboard
978       })
979       .catch(function () { send.disabled = false; send.textContent = 'Send'; receipt('That did not go through — nothing was done.', true); });
980   }
981   if (send) send.addEventListener('click', doSend);
982   if (say) say.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) { e.preventDefault(); doSend(); } });

984   // a redeploy reloads the open page, as the old home did (the verification law: a mechanism, not "refresh"): /api/version
985   // every 30 s; a build other than the one this page booted with reloads it once — never while he is typing
986   (function () {
987     var mine = (window.ANCHOR_BOOT && window.ANCHOR_BOOT.build_id) || '';
988     if (!mine) return;
989     // W2c-4: never while he types; W3b: never under an open tile either - the renewal waits (renew), the draft and the open tile come back after it
990     setInterval(function () {
991       fetch('/api/version', { cache: 'no-store' }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
992         var v = d && d.version; if (!v || v === mine) return;
993         try { if (sessionStorage.getItem('highseat_reloaded_for') === String(v)) return; } catch (e) {}
994         renewVersion = String(v); renew('A new build is live \u2014 the page is renewed.');
995       }).catch(function () {});
996     }, 30000);
997   })();
998 })();
